visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Factorial Lookup Table
visualizerParams.problemDescription: isStrong() recomputes a factorial for every digit. Refactor it to use a pre-calculated array of the factorials of 0-9.

solution.explanation: Since we only care about factorials of digits (0-9), using a pre-calculated lookup table is much more efficient than recalculating the factorial every time.
